messages:
ashley: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal to decompose the v1 compatibility shim into three orthogonal layers: ingress-normalizer, protocol-adapter, postprocessor. Avoid a single monolith shim that handles everything.
nav: +1. can we scope ownership? my vote: ingress-normalizer -> eng-platform, protocol-adapter -> eng-runtime, postprocessor -> eng-ml (output shaping).
maria: Concern: splitting increases cross-team coupling for canary rollouts. How do we coordinate rollout guards?
ashley: plan: tenant flagging + staged lifecycle. each layer exposes a small health endpoint and a "compat-version" header. rollout steps in thread below.
jordan: agree with health endpoints. Also want telemetry: per-tenant compat.latency, compat.error-rate, compat.mismatch-count.
sam: small nit: postprocessor might need model-level features (tokenizer id) — eng-ml should own but runtime needs metadata.
ashley: noted. propose owner matrix in doc and oncall for first 48h post-cutover.
maria: timeline? we need customers notice window 6 weeks.
ashley: target: 6-week runway. Week 1: prototype split locally. Week 2-3: infra + e2e tests. Week 4: internal canary. Week 5: tenant opt-in. Week 6: open-rollout with kill-switch.
nav: kill-switch mechanics? how to forcibly turn off globally?
ashley: implement `compat.v1.enable` in feature-gate service, and fallback route that maps to /v2 endpoints. Example:
```
POST /v1/generate -> X-Compat-Version: v2
feature-gate: compat.v1.enable=false -> route to /v2
```
maria: how do we measure regressions in quality? We need baseline eval prompt set and automated sampling.
jordan: +1, set up sampling 1% of requests to double-run through v2 and compare embeddings/LLM outputs.
sam: perf impact? double-run will add cost.
ashley: agree — do opt-in sampling only for flagged tenants and use async batch compare to minimize tail latency.
nav: rollback plan: 1) flip feature-gate; 2) move traffic to v2; 3) invalidate compat caches; 4) patch config. documented.
maria: do we need a compatibility SLA note for Dedicated customers?
ashley: yes, add to enterprise runbook accessory. also ensure KMS/HSM keys unaffected.
deploy-bot: diff-deploy: ingress-normalizer v1.0 -> deployed to staging at 1768880100 :white_check_mark:
maria: will take the ownership matrix and make PR to architecture repo.
ashley: thanks. I'll draft the canary playbook and telemetry dashboard (compat:latency,comp:errors,mismatch-count).
nav: tagging infra for capacity planning; batching adjustments might be needed.
jordan: can we unify header for version sniffing? propose `X-Client-Compat: v1` and `X-Compat-Fallback: v2`.
sam: +1 simpler than body sniffing.
maria: closing note: keep it minimal on path transformations — prefer header-driven routing.
ashley: cool. I'll update the RFC and drop a link when ready. :eyes:
